newsitem.title: NICARAGUA: Costa Rican president has heart attack - radio.
newsitem.headline: Costa Rican president has heart attack - radio.

text.p: Costa Rican President Jose Maria Figueres suffered a heart attack on Monday during a meeting of Central American presidents in Nicaragua and was taken to hospital, the state-owned Radio Nicaragua said.

"A half hour ago, in the Plaza of the Republic, President Jose Maria Figueres of Costa Rica had a heart attack and was transferred to the Military Hospital," the radio said without elaborating on his condition.
The Costa Rican government would neither confirm nor deny whether Figueres, 42, had a heart attack.
However, a statement from Managua's Military Hospital said Figuers had acute abdominal pains.
He was in hospital in "stable" condition, the statement said.
Liliana Soliz, a presidential spokeswoman in San Jose, Costa Rica, said the president "felt indisposed" and was under examination, but declined to comment further.
